final: WITH baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals), status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), kept AS (SELECT status, avg_modindex, overall_avg FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE avg_modindex > overall_avg) SELECT status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - overall_avg AS above_baseline, avg_modindex - AVG(avg_modindex) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept
